CR1.label: Technical & platform issues

CR1.1.label: Login or authentication failure
CR1.1.description: Customer cannot sign in: password not working, account locked, MFA not functioning, SSO issues, or session expiring unexpectedly.

CR1.2.label: Application error or crash
CR1.2.description: Customer encounters an error message, application crash, exception, or unexpected termination that prevents normal use.

CR1.3.label: Performance degradation or slow response
CR1.3.description: Application or service is noticeably slower than expected, timing out, or experiencing intermittent delays that impair usability.

CR1.4.label: Feature not working as expected
CR1.4.description: A specific product feature behaves incorrectly, produces wrong results, or does not behave as documented or as the customer expects.

CR1.5.label: Integration or API issue
CR1.5.description: A third-party integration, webhook, or API call is failing, returning incorrect data, or not authenticating correctly.

CR1.6.label: Data loss or corruption
CR1.6.description: Customer reports that data has been deleted, corrupted, or is displaying incorrectly within the application.

CR1.7.label: Other technical issue
CR1.7.description: A technical problem that does not fit any other sub-category above.

CR1.description: Customer contacts support because a product, service, or platform is not functioning as expected. Covers errors, outages, performance problems, and integration failures.

CR2.label: Billing & payment

CR2.1.label: Invoice query or dispute
CR2.1.description: Customer questions the accuracy of an invoice, requests a copy, or disputes a charge.

CR2.2.label: Payment failure or declined transaction
CR2.2.description: Payment could not be processed: card declined, bank transfer failed, or payment gateway error.

CR2.3.label: Subscription or plan change request
CR2.3.description: Customer wants to upgrade, downgrade, pause, or modify their subscription or plan tier.

CR2.4.label: Overcharge or unexpected charge
CR2.4.description: Customer was charged more than expected, charged twice, or charged for something they did not authorise.

CR2.5.label: Refund or credit request
CR2.5.description: Customer requests a refund for a charge they believe is incorrect or for a service they are dissatisfied with.

CR2.6.label: Other billing issue
CR2.6.description: A billing or payment issue that does not fit another sub-category.

CR2.description: Customer contacts support about financial transactions: invoices, charges, payment methods, subscriptions, or refunds related to billing.

CR3.label: Account & access management

CR3.1.label: Password reset or recovery
CR3.1.description: Customer needs to reset or recover their password, or cannot complete the password reset flow.

CR3.2.label: Account locked or suspended
CR3.2.description: Customer account has been suspended, locked due to failed login attempts, or restricted by a security or compliance action.

CR3.3.label: Update account details
CR3.3.description: Customer wants to change their email address, name, contact details, billing address, or other profile information.

CR3.4.label: Multi-factor authentication issue
CR3.4.description: Customer cannot complete MFA: lost authenticator device, phone number changed, backup codes not working.

CR3.5.label: Account deletion or data removal request
CR3.5.description: Customer requests deletion of their account or removal of personal data under GDPR, CCPA, or similar regulations.

CR3.6.label: User permissions or role management
CR3.6.description: Customer needs to adjust user roles, add or remove team members, or change permission levels within the account.

CR3.7.label: Other account management issue
CR3.7.description: An account or access request that does not fit another sub-category.

CR3.description: Customer needs help managing their account: credentials, profile details, permissions, or account lifecycle actions such as creation, deletion, or transfer.

CR4.label: Product inquiry

CR4.1.label: Feature availability or capability question
CR4.1.description: Customer asks whether a specific feature exists or is included in their plan.

CR4.2.label: Pricing or licensing question
CR4.2.description: Customer asks about pricing tiers, seat licences, enterprise pricing, or contract terms.

CR4.3.label: How-to or usage guidance
CR4.3.description: Customer needs step-by-step instructions on how to use a feature they already have access to.

CR4.4.label: Compatibility or integration question
CR4.4.description: Customer asks whether the product is compatible with their tech stack, OS, or third-party tool.

CR4.5.label: Other product inquiry
CR4.5.description: A product or service question that does not fit another sub-category.

CR4.description: Customer is seeking information about the product or service: features, pricing, compatibility, usage guidance, or documentation.

CR5.label: Complaint

CR5.1.label: Product quality dissatisfaction
CR5.1.description: Customer expresses dissatisfaction with the quality, reliability, or performance of the product.

CR5.2.label: Agent behaviour or service quality complaint
CR5.2.description: Customer complains about the behaviour, attitude, or professionalism of a support agent.

CR5.3.label: Process or policy complaint
CR5.3.description: Customer disagrees with or is frustrated by a company policy, process, or rule.

CR5.4.label: Unresolved prior issue complaint
CR5.4.description: Customer contacts again because a previous issue was not resolved or the resolution did not hold.

CR5.5.label: Other complaint
CR5.5.description: A complaint that does not fit another sub-category.

CR5.description: Customer contacts support primarily to express dissatisfaction with the product, service quality, or a prior support interaction.

CR6.label: Delivery & logistics

CR6.1.label: Delayed or late delivery
CR6.1.description: Shipment has not arrived by the expected date and the customer is following up.

CR6.2.label: Missing or lost item
CR6.2.description: Customer did not receive their package, or the tracking shows delivered but item not received.

CR6.3.label: Damaged item on arrival
CR6.3.description: Product arrived physically damaged due to shipping or handling.

CR6.4.label: Wrong item delivered
CR6.4.description: Customer received an incorrect product - wrong item, colour, size, or quantity.

CR6.5.label: Delivery address or scheduling issue
CR6.5.description: Customer needs to change delivery address, reschedule a delivery slot, or the delivery was attempted at the wrong address.

CR6.6.label: Other delivery issue
CR6.6.description: A delivery or logistics issue that does not fit another sub-category.

CR6.description: Customer contacts support about the physical delivery of goods or the logistics of a physical order. Applicable to products with a physical fulfilment component.

CR7.label: Data & privacy

CR7.1.label: Subject access request (SAR)
CR7.1.description: Customer requests a copy of all personal data held about them under GDPR or equivalent.

CR7.2.label: Data correction request
CR7.2.description: Customer requests that incorrect personal data be corrected or updated in company systems.

CR7.3.label: Marketing opt-out or communication preferences
CR7.3.description: Customer requests to unsubscribe from marketing, update notification settings, or manage communication preferences.

CR7.4.label: Data breach or security concern
CR7.4.description: Customer is concerned that their data may have been exposed, compromised, or misused.

CR7.5.label: Other data or privacy request
CR7.5.description: A data or privacy request that does not fit another sub-category.

CR7.description: Customer contacts support about personal data: access requests, correction, deletion, opt-outs, or data security concerns.

CR8.label: Returns & exchanges

CR8.1.label: Initiate a return
CR8.1.description: Customer wants to start a return of a product they no longer want or that was faulty.

CR8.2.label: Return status enquiry
CR8.2.description: Customer is following up on a return already initiated, checking refund status or receipt of returned item.

CR8.3.label: Exchange request
CR8.3.description: Customer wants to swap a product for a different size, colour, or model.

CR8.4.label: Return policy question
CR8.4.description: Customer is asking about the terms of the returns policy before initiating a return.

CR8.5.label: Other returns issue
CR8.5.description: A returns or exchange issue that does not fit another sub-category.

CR8.description: Customer wants to return a product, request an exchange, or enquire about the returns process.

CR9.label: General enquiry

CR9.1.label: General product or company question
CR9.1.description: Customer asks a broad question about the company, product range, or service offering.

CR9.2.label: Feedback or suggestion
CR9.2.description: Customer proactively shares feedback, an idea, or a suggestion without reporting an issue.

CR9.3.label: Other general enquiry
CR9.3.description: A general contact that does not fit any other category.

CR9.description: Customer has a general question or comment that does not require resolution of a specific issue.
